subject: Medical reentry: phased-hours & coverage plan
body:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Medical reentry: phased-hours & coverage plan

Hi Marissa + Laura,

I wanted to start the thread for my planned reentry after the medical leave. My physician has given a tentative clearance with a recommended phased schedule starting 25% for week 1, 50% for weeks 2-3, then reassess for full duties by week 6 (if tolerated). I know this will require temporary coverage and a clearer handoff for the ongoing product roadmap work.

High-level asks: 
- Confirmation of coverage for my on-call rotations and the Friday stakeholder syncs (I can keep attending asynchronously where needed).
- A short-term owners matrix for the next 6 weeks so I’m not juggling conflicting requests as I ramp.
- HR forms I should complete (FMLA paperwork / accommodation request).

I’m attaching an initial handoff doc (draft) and will follow up with the physician note as soon as I have the signed clearance. Happy to be flexible on the exact hours; the 25/50 ramp is a medical recommendation.

Thanks,
Irene
Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: handover_notes_iri_ne-team.docx (docx, 38KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medical reentry: phased-hours & coverage plan

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the heads-up — glad to hear the clearance is moving in a positive direction. I’ve attached the FMLA and reasonable accommodation forms. To make this as smooth as possible, please: 
- Complete the FMLA_request_form.pdf and upload to the HR portal (link below).
- Share the signed doctor_clearance when available.
- Let me know if you’ll need any ergonomic accommodations (chair/monitor adjustments) for partial days.

We’ll treat this request as confidential; I’ll loop in People Ops only as needed for paperwork. If you’d like, I can draft a short, neutral all-hands message that Marissa can send to the team announcing your phased return and coverage owners.

Laura
People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: FMLA_request_form.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
Related link: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/FMLA-request-2026

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jack Sullivan <jack.sullivan@contractors.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medical reentry: phased-hours & coverage plan

Team — quick operational reply with a proposed coverage plan based on Irene’s suggested ramp: 

1) Week of Jul 5 (25%):
   - Irene: Focused async review windows (11:00–13:00 PT) + 2x short 30-min check-ins (Mon/Wed). No on-call.
   - Jack (contractor): Primary for urgent on-call triage; Marissa backup.
   - Friday stakeholder sync: Jack will present; Irene will provide bullet notes by Thu EOD.

2) Weeks of Jul 12–19 (50%):
   - Irene: Two half-days (Tues/Thurs 09:30–15:00 PT) including 1x live planning session each week. No customer-facing demos without Marissa.
   - Team: Temporary reassign of roadmap tickets #RL-342, #RL-356 to Marissa’s rota with clear acceptance criteria.

3) Week of Jul 26:
   - Reassess based on physician clearance and Irene’s energy levels for potential full return.

Operational asks:
- Irene: please confirm the two time windows you can reliably hold during week 1 so we can lock calendar invites (so we don’t schedule async work that requires live review).
- Laura: once HR has the formal FMLA file, can you confirm that benefits/leave dates are updated and that we’re covered for the contractor extension (Jack’s contract runs through Jul 31 unless extended)?

I’ve attached a short handoff with ticket ownership and temporary escalation contacts. I’ll send calendar hold invites after Irene confirms windows.

—Marissa
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: handover_notes_iri_ne-team.docx (updated, 45KB)

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jack Sullivan <jack.sullivan@contractors.com>, Dr. Anne Wallace <awallace@occhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medical reentry: phased-hours & coverage plan

Thanks, both. I accept the proposed schedule and the assigned coverage. Confirming for week of Jul 5: my reliable async window will be 10:30–13:00 PT each day (I can do two 30-min live check-ins Mon/Wed at 11:00).

Attached: signed doctor clearance (doctor_clearance_awallace.pdf). I also completed the FMLA request and uploaded it to the HR portal this morning (confirmation ID: HR-2026-07-10-IR).

A couple of quick notes:
- Jack, thank you for stepping into on-call — I left a prioritized triage doc in the shared drive (link below).
- Marissa: I’m fine with not leading customer demos during the 50% ramp; please copy me into post-demo notes.

If everything looks good to you both, happy for Marissa to send the neutral team note and for Laura to finalize the FMLA entry. I’ll check in at the end of week 1 with a quick health/status update.

Irene
Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: doctor_clearance_awallace.pdf (pdf, 28KB), FMLA_submission_receipt.png (png, 12KB)
Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/eng/irene-handover-notes
